newsitem.title: GERMANY: German SPD's Lafontaine rejects further tax talks.
newsitem.headline: German SPD's Lafontaine rejects further tax talks.

text.p: Oskar Lafontaine, head of the opposition Social Democrats (SPD), said on Friday he rejects the government's invitation to further talks on tax reform.

The chance for agreement has been missed because the government rejected the SPD's call for cuts in taxes and other withholdings in 1998, a year earlier than now planned, Lafontaine told the Westdeutsche Allgemeine Zeitung.

"The tax reform proposals of (Chancellor Helmut) Kohl's government would not reduce unemployment, they would increase it, because they would restrain investment and not boost domestic demand," Lafontaine said.
Lafontaine said he still expected the upper house of parliament, where the SPD holds a majority, to block the government's tax reform plans.
